subject: Automation for www.linkedin.com — manual labor / operational overhead
body:
I saw you're dealing with manual labor / operational overhead.

The problem: Manual Labor / Operational Overhead eats into your team's bandwidth.

The outcome: We guarantee 60%+ time reduction on your targeted process within 30 days, or you pay nothing.

We build browser automation bots that replace manual work with scheduled scripts.

Reply 'DEMO' and I'll send a 2-minute Loom showing what we built for a similar client.

P.S. Know someone who'd benefit? Refer them during signup and you both get $50 credit + 10% off + 30 days extension.

lead_brief.suggested_pitch: Automated solution for www.linkedin.com targeting Manual Labor / Operational Overhead. Build: 2-3 days. Price: fixed scope. No long-term contract required.

recommended_package.name: single_bot_package
recommended_package.description: Focused automation for one high-impact process
